text:
tess.sales: Heads upwe have a POC request from a bank. They want PrivateLink into their VPC and insist on fixed egress IPs and source-IP-preservation for internal audit logs. Need a short options summary + firewall snippet.

nina.sol: Clarify: will their apps call our endpoint (PrivateLink) or do we need to call their downstream services?

chad.ae: They call our endpoint; downstream systems are in their VPC and must see original client IP.

oliver.net: Options: 1) PrivateLink + reserved EIPs (customer allowlists our EIPs) simple but dest sees our EIP. 2) L3 VPN/Direct Connect + TGW peering preserves src IP natively. 3) PrivateLink + customer-run connector (we ship container) that forwards without SNAT.

rachel.sec: If auditors require true TCP srcIP, option 2 or 3 needed. App-level auth (mTLS/JWT) may be acceptable as compensating control.

oliver.net: Firewall allowlist sample for option 1:
```
allow tcp from any to 18.197.45.101/32 port 443 comment "redwood-eip-1"
```

nina.sol: I'll draft the pricing delta for reserved EIPs and request billing numbers.

infra-bot: Attach privatedeploy network runbook to invite: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/privatedeploy-network

tess.sales: Thanks. I'll send the two-architecture email and book netops sync. :thumbsup:
